craft_notes: Sthāyin: exclusion-joy. Close: attain (denied). Rejected: 'mindfulness' for smaryamāṇatva — killed: being-remembered kept; 'Brahman' — killed: reality kept.

lines: Hence the made-thing is known as ever like deep sleep;
but not as thus-remembered can that reality attain.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atas tatkṛtrimaṃ jñeyaṃ sauṣuptapadavat sadā | na tv evaṃ smaryamāṇatvaṃ tat tattvam pratipadyate

reads_against.argmap: Hence that made-thing to be known as ever like deep sleep; but thus being-remembered, that reality does not attain.
c1_essence: Made-thing like deep-sleep ever; not thus-remembered reality attains.
